purpose: Expand beyond latest prediction-ledger revisions using actually stored pregame odds snapshots, not closing archive prices.
not_blind: Original14 and initial21 counterfactual results already seen. This wider cohort is another retrospective diagnostic, not an untouched holdout.
quote_selection: For each direct official MLB winner product, take the latest stored quote strictly before T30, exactseason/round/gameNo/teams/date/nway. Then merge duplicate physical event offers deterministically by latest observation; no outcome-based offer choice.
decision_time: Counterfactual decision time equals quote.observed_at; votes must have been received by that time. This is NOT a historical captured model prediction. quote timestamp and source row_id preserved, no prediction/capture event fabricated.
sources: First observed eligible ungraded native ML text from multiple author handles. An expert-price quote is unnecessary because stake payout uses same captured Proto price vector for all strategies. Optional expert-price text retained but not price input.
price_model: Repository devig.shin applied to captured complete two-way vector, normalized; not fitted.
primary_comparison: Unique-plurality fixtures common to allthree strategies, rawtie/abstention universe reported separately. No oldoperatingperformance relabelled as vote performance.
integrity: Read-only exported quote payload and original vote envelopes hash-pinned, official DOM bytes/row/kickoff/source game verified. Stored observed_at is local source metadata, not external time or executable price certification.
retained_model_catalog: Player/M0/M1/M2/residual/lineup families saved separately; no model deletion/automatic adoption/deployment.
